messages:
amelia: Heads up — customer ACME-LLM (org: acme-prod) reports p95/p99 lines missing from their tenant SLO panel after the ingress canary rolled out at ~08:10 UTC. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/acme/12345 :eyes:
juan: Investigating. Which region? us-west-2?
amelia: Yes, us-west-2. They say org-level dashboard still shows lines, but tenant view blanks out the percentiles.
oliver: I can repro on staging by toggling tenant filter. Quick check — are percentile series getting dropped at ingest?
sre-bot: alert: telemetry-ingest-canary deployed by deploy-bot at 2469993200
nora: Amelia can you DM customer a workaround: switch to 'org view' or add the tenant tag in the query for now?
amelia: Done. Customer can see org view, but needs tenant SLOs for SLA reporting.
juan: Captured a span from the live ingest: `curl -s https://telemetry.internal/ingest/metrics?tenant=acme-prod | jq '.series[] | select(.metric=="latency.p95")'` returns empty.
oliver: On the canary nodes the transform config removes percentile labels if tag remap present — looks like `map_labels: remove: ["percentile"]` got flipped in the new transform. Posting diff:
```
- map_labels:
-  remove: ["percentile"]
+ map_labels:
+  keep: ["percentile"]
```
juan: Rolling a hotfix to the canary config now — applying patch to telemetry-ingest-canary configmap.
sre-bot: deploy job started: telemetry-ingest-canary/hotfix-2469993456
oliver: Patch applied on 2/3 canary nodes, reloading transforms.
amelia: Customer confirms they see p95/p99 back in tenant panel :tada:
juan: Will promote fix to next canary and then stable. Filing follow-up change to avoid label-remap regression.
nora: Adding regression test to verify tenant-view percentile series preserved.
amelia: Closing with customer; they asked for postmortem. I'll open a ticket.
support-bot: ticket created: SPT-4589
juan: Thanks all — root cause: accidental remove-labels in canary transform. Mitigation: config guard and CI check.
